stages.native:
WITH setup AS (
SELECT
  `assign_job_candidate_8987`.`job_name` AS `job_name`,
  `assign_job_candidate_8987`.`candidate_full_name` AS `candidate_full_name`,
  `assign_job_candidate_8987`.`hiring_stage` AS `hiring_stage`,
  `assign_job_candidate_8987`.`hiring_stage_date` AS `hiring stage date`,
  LEAD(`assign_job_candidate_8987`.`hiring_stage_date`, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY `job_name`, `candidate_full_name` ORDER BY `hiring_stage_date` ASC) AS `next hiring stage date`,

			CASE 
    WHEN `hiring stage date` IS NOT NULL 
         AND `next hiring stage date` IS NOT NULL
    THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(
            SECOND,
            CAST(`assign_job_candidate_8987`.`updated_on` AS DATETIME),
            LEAD(
                CAST(`assign_job_candidate_8987`.`updated_on` AS DATETIME),
                1
            ) OVER (
                PARTITION BY `job_name`, `candidate_full_name`
                ORDER BY `updated_on` ASC
            )
         )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS `duration in current stage`
  
FROM
  `assign_job_candidate_8987`
WHERE {{job_name}} AND {{job_date}}
)

SELECT 
    `hiring_stage`,
	
    coalesce(ceil(AVG(`duration in current stage`)/(60*60*24)), 0) AS `average time spent in this stage`
FROM setup
GROUP BY `hiring_stage`
